[[File:CorellianFriedIceCream.png|thumb|right|225px|Corellian Fried Ice Cream]]
'''Ice cream''' was a frozen snack made from [[:Category:Dairy products|dairy products]] and came in various flavors across the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. Soft ice cream could be served in cones like [[Cerean cone]]s. [[Darth Nox]] once claimed to have a dream where a group of relics produced different flavors of the food.<ref name="SWtoR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

{{Talesstart}}
[[Melvin Fett]] thought [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] was a "dessert" planet and expected to find it filled with [[Cupcake/Legends|cupcakes]] and ice cream.<ref name="Melvin Fett comic">{{Tales|20|Melvin Fett (comic story)}}</ref>
{{Talesend}}
